title: Choose the dashboard composition
question: Soft Luxury Salon is fixed. Choose how the customer and admin dashboards should organize daily work.

options.label: Vanity Tray Workspace
options.lineage: a composed salon counter with purpose-built trays
options.thesis: Every task receives a precise place, like tools arranged before a treatment.
options.viewport: Customer: next visit and booking action anchor the largest tray. Admin: today's queue anchors the same system with status, customer, and service trays around it.
options.risk: Needs disciplined hierarchy so the tray system does not become a generic card grid.

options.label: Ritual Path
options.lineage: a treatment journey from selection through completion
options.thesis: The dashboard reads as one calm path: choose, confirm, arrive, complete, remember.
options.viewport: Customer: the current appointment stage leads a horizontal ritual path. Admin: appointments group by stage with today's exceptions called forward.
options.risk: A timeline can become slow for staff unless dense queues remain directly scannable.

options.label: Appointment Atelier
options.lineage: a working studio bench with a dedicated inspector
options.thesis: One central workspace holds the task while a quiet side inspector keeps context visible.
options.viewport: Customer: services and time selection occupy the workbench with a persistent booking summary. Admin: schedule and records occupy the workbench with appointment details in the inspector.
options.risk: Its strong desktop structure needs careful stacking to stay graceful on phones.
